## Changes

Complete the author workspace with real profile, novel and wallet data; reader ratings/reviews; novel and chapter comments with author management/replies; and the shared StoryCraft Light/Dark/System theme. Includes the author overview, profile and manuscript import screens.

## Validation

- Backend/frontend TypeScript checks passed.
- Latest verification: 49 backend tests and 12 frontend tests passed.
- Docker backend/web builds passed.
- Chrome checks covered author/reader/admin routes, comments, Light/Dark and mobile layouts.

## Follow-up

A separate branch will address draft/VIP access control, draft reliability, revision recovery and remaining author workflows identified during review.

prs.body:
## Changes
- Protect drafts, revisions and VIP content with active-account and ownership checks.
- Add reliable draft saving, local recovery, revision history and restore.
- Add chapter lifecycle actions and scheduled publishing through moderation.
- Persist uploaded media and make manuscript imports retry-safe.
- Add durable author notifications and an unread-count badge.
- Complete editable author profiles and refine the profile header and Studio actions.

## Validation
- 52 backend tests and 12 frontend tests passed during implementation.
- Backend/frontend type checks and production Docker builds passed.
- Browser checks covered author workflows, Light/Dark themes and responsive layouts.

## Database
Includes migrations `015_author_workflow.sql` and `016_author_launch_checklist.sql`.

## Merge order
Targets `feat/author-workspace` and includes only the new author workflow commit. Merge this PR before #54 to include these changes in the workspace PR to `main`.
